info.name: Activeloop Deep Lake Managed Database API
Run a TQL query against the Managed Tensor Database (Alpha).

items.docs: Executes a Tensor Query Language (TQL) query against a dataset hosted in the Activeloop Managed Tensor Database (datasets created with `runtime={"tensor_db": True}`). This endpoint is documented as Alpha and its syntax may change without announcement. Most Deep Lake usage runs through the Python SDK rather than this endpoint.
